items.actClause: AN ACT to amend the legislative law, in relation to requiring that committee and floor votes be made available online and that session and committee meetings be webcast
items.memo:
BILL NUMBER:S3046

TITLE OF BILL:  An act to amend the legislative law, in relation to
requiring that committee and floor votes be made available online and
that session and committee meetings be webcast

PURPOSE:  This legislation requires that committee and floor votes are
made public online and that session and committee meeting are webcast.

SUMMARY OF PROVISIONS:

Section 1: Adds a new section to 54-c of the Legislative law which
requires all committee and floor votes by the Senate and Assembly be
listed online within 24 hours of the vote on each houses perspective
website. This listing will include the bill number, date of vote, the
summary of legislation from the legislative retrieval system, whether
such vote was on the floor or in a committee and each member's vote
listed as aye or nay. It is requires that every committee meeting of
the Legislature and every session shall be webcast through the
official website of each respective house.

Section 2: This legislation will take effect on the 120th day after it
shall have become law.

JUSTIFICATION:  This legislation seeks to allow access to the
proceedings and voting records of committee and session activities
conducted by both houses of the State Legislature.

Currently, many of the activities discussed in this legislation are
shared through webcasts. However, it is important all the actions of
the State Legislature are provided in a location that is easily
accessible to those represented by State Legislative Officials.

The availability of this information will allow the interested public
to follow day to day activities of the State Legislature as well as
their elected representatives actions in Albany.

LEGISLATIVE HISTORY:  S. 7487 - Referred to Investigations and
Government Operations

FISCAL IMPLICATIONS: Minimal.

EFFECTIVE DATE:  This act shall take effect on the one hundred
twentieth day after it shall have become law.

C.actClause: AN ACT to amend the legislative law, in relation to requiring that committee and floor votes be made available online and that session and committee meetings be live webcast and archived
C.memo:
BILL NUMBER:S3046C

TITLE OF BILL:  An act to amend the legislative law, in relation to
requiring that committee and floor votes be made available online and
that session and committee meetings be live webcast and archived

PURPOSE:

This legislation requires that committee and floor votes are made
public online and that session and committee meeting are live webcast
and archived.

SUMMARY OF PROVISIONS:

Section 1: Adds a new section to 54-c of the Legislative law which
requires all committee and floor votes by the Senate and Assembly be
listed online within 24 hours, or to the extent practicable, of the
vote on each houses perspective website. This listing will include the
bill number, date of vote, the summary of legislation from the
legislative retrieval system, whether such vote was on the floor or in
a committee and each member's vote listed as aye, nay, excused,
absent, or abstain. It is requires that every committee meeting of the
Legislature and every session shall be live webcast and archived
through the official website of each respective house.

Section 2: This legislation will take effect on the 120th day after it
shall have become law.

JUSTIFICATION:

This legislation seeks to allow access to the proceedings and voting
records of committee and session activities conducted by both houses
of the State Legislature.

Currently, many of the activities discussed in this legislation are
shared through webcasts. However, it is important all the actions of
the State Legislature are provided in a location that is easily
accessible to those represented by State Legislative Officials.  The
availability of this information will allow the interested public to
follow day to day activities of the State Legislature as well as their
elected representatives actions in Albany.

LEGISLATIVE HISTORY:

S. 7487 - Referred to Investigations and Government Operations

FISCAL IMPLICATIONS:

Minimal.

EFFECTIVE DATE:

This act shall take effect on the one hundred twentieth day after it
shall have become law; provided, however, that the obligation to
archive webcasts of committee meetings, hearings, and sessions of the
legislature as provided in section one of this act shall only apply to
webcasts occurring on or after the effective date of this act.
